title: Mozilla ie simplified landing page win

change.control: IE landing page with main features, switching tips, deep footer and download stats.
change.variant: Keep download stats, remove the main features and switching tips, and simplify the footer while retaining legal/privacy/trademark links.

significance.reported: Publisher reports 99% confidence interval for the best combined variation.

quote: The simplest variation (far right image) performed the best, increasing the download conversion rate by 2.3%, at the 99% confidence interval.
notes: Combined-recipe versus original comparison from the same multivariate test as the factor-level records; not an independent study. Outcome includes subsequent downloads after seeing the landing page, not only immediate clicks. Business type reflects the nonprofit-owned browser organization; the conversion is a browser download, not a SaaS subscription.

verification_details.reason: company, lift and supporting quote confirmed; not a statistical replication
